## Objectives

1. Defeat 50 [Strand Fox](../monsters/strand_fox.md)
2. Look at the prints at the last stump in [Goa Harbour](../maps/goa_harbour.md)

## Rewards

- 7,000 EXP
- 1,120 mesos
- [Strand Fox Hood](../items/strand_fox_hood.md) x1
- +25 standing with Goa Harbour
- +150 standing with [Kenna](../npcs/kenna_hunter.md)
